name: Green Living
grammar: Relative clauses referring to a whole sentence

notes.title: Động từ đi với giới từ (Verbs with prepositions) và cụm động từ
notes.body:
1. Động từ + giới từ (+ tân ngữ): nghĩa thường gần với nghĩa gốc của động từ.
• about: ask about, care about, talk about, think about, learn about
• for: ask for, apply for, apologise for, wait for, prepare for
• on: agree on, base on (be based on), depend on, rely on
• to: introduce to, refer to, respond to, listen to, explain to
Sau giới từ dùng danh từ/đại từ hoặc V-ing: apologise for leaving the lights on.

2. Cụm động từ (phrasal verbs): động từ + giới từ/trạng từ, nghĩa thường KHÁC hẳn nghĩa gốc: work out (tìm ra), carry out (tiến hành), turn on/off (bật/tắt), look for (tìm), look after (chăm sóc), look up (tra cứu), throw away (vứt bỏ), clean up (dọn sạch), rinse out (tráng rửa), get rid of (loại bỏ).

3. Ví dụ trong sách
• Many people have now started to care about the environment.
• The future of our planet depends on how we deal with climate change.
• We should work out some solutions to reducing plastic pollution.
• My sister is responsible for looking after the plants at home.

4. Lỗi hay gặp
• ✗ depend in/of → ✓ depend on; ✗ apologise about → ✓ apologise for.
• ✗ care for the environment (care for = chăm sóc/thích) → nói chung nên dùng care about.
• ✗ instead to + V → ✓ instead of + V-ing.
• Nhầm look after / look for / look up do cùng động từ gốc.

notes.title: Mệnh đề quan hệ thay cho cả câu (which)
notes.body:
1. Cách dùng: mệnh đề quan hệ KHÔNG xác định có thể thay cho TOÀN BỘ thông tin của mệnh đề đứng trước (không chỉ một danh từ).

2. Cấu trúc: Mệnh đề 1, which + V (số ít) …
• Luôn có dấu phẩy trước which.
• Chỉ dùng which – KHÔNG dùng that, what, it, this.
• which thay cho một sự việc → động từ chia số ít: which is / which helps / which saves.

3. Ví dụ
• More and more people are interested in recycling nowadays, which is good for the environment. (= Việc ngày càng nhiều người quan tâm tái chế là tốt cho môi trường.)
• I always turn off the fans when I leave the room, which helps save energy.
• Plastic takes hundreds of years to decompose in the ground, which explains why it is harmful to the environment.
• All students work very hard to help clean up the school, which the teacher encourages.

4. Cách nối câu: câu thứ hai bắt đầu bằng This/That/It (chỉ cả câu trước) → bỏ This/That, thay bằng ", which". Nếu This là tân ngữ: "… The teacher encourages this." → "…, which the teacher encourages." (không giữ lại this/it).

5. Lỗi hay gặp: ✗ …, that is good → ✓ …, which is good; ✗ which help/are → ✓ which helps/is; ✗ …, it is good (lỗi nối hai mệnh đề bằng dấu phẩy); quên giới từ khi which làm tân ngữ: ✓ …, which the teachers are pleased about.

notes.title: Nguyên âm đôi /ɪə/, /eə/, /ʊə/
notes.body:
• /ɪə/: idea, years, near, clear, hear, fear, year, appear, volunteer, career, here. Chữ thường gặp: ear, eer, ere, ea (idea).
• /eə/: awareness, air conditioners, fair, hair, pair, pear, bear, wear, care, share, there, where. Chữ thường gặp: air, are, ear, ere.
• /ʊə/: sure, ecotour, pure, cure, mature, tour (Anh-Anh còn đọc /ɔː/ ở sure, tour).

Bẫy hay gặp:
• Cùng chữ ear: near /nɪə/ ≠ bear, pear, wear /eə/.
• Cùng chữ ere: here /hɪə/ ≠ there, where /eə/; were /wɜː/.
• ure ở âm tiết KHÔNG nhấn đọc /ə/: future /ˈfjuːtʃə/, picture, culture, literature ≠ pure, sure /ʊə/.
• ai trước r đọc /eə/ (fair, repair) nhưng container, remain đọc /eɪ/; are đứng một mình đọc /ɑː/.

Trọng âm từ vựng Unit: re'cycle, re'usable, re'cyclable, con'tainer, pol'lutant, ˌdecom'pose (âm 3),'landfill, 'packaging, 'leftovers, 'compost, 'fertiliser, sus'tainable, en'vironment → envi'ronmental (âm 4).

notes.title: Từ vựng và cụm từ về lối sống xanh
notes.body:
• reduce, reuse, recycle (3R); recyclable (adj) – có thể tái chế; reusable (adj) ↔ single-use (adj).
• waste (n): rác thải / sự lãng phí – a waste of electricity/water; household waste; landfill (bãi chôn lấp); packaging (bao bì); container (hộp đựng); cardboard box.
• decompose (phân hủy): Plastic takes hundreds of years to decompose.
• reduce our carbon footprint; raise environmental awareness; use resources efficiently.
• develop eco-friendly habits; clean up the classroom; refill reusable bottles; turn off the lights.
• get rid of plastic packaging; keep leftovers in the fridge; rinse out containers; the bin was contaminated.
• Compost: compost pile, a layer of dry leaves, fruit peels, chemical fertilisers.
• CLIL: sustainable future, greenhouse gases, harmful pollutants, sky lanterns, fireworks, wildfires.
• Dự đoán (Everyday English): I guess/think/expect…; (very certain) … is going to…; (quite certain) … will…; (not certain) … may/might…; It's likely/unlikely that…; It's hard to predict/say…; in the long/short/medium term; in the long run.

notes.title: Mẹo làm bài
notes.body:
• Câu có dấu phẩy + chỗ trống + động từ, thay cho cả ý trước → chọn which; loại ngay that/what/who/it.
• Sau ", which" thay cho cả câu, động từ chia số ít (is, helps, saves, explains).
• Bài tìm lỗi: soát giới từ sau động từ (depend on, rely on, apologise for, care about, explain to, be based on) và V-ing sau giới từ (by turning off, instead of throwing).
• Phrasal verb: nhớ theo cặp nghĩa dễ nhầm: look after/for/up; turn on/off; throw away; carry out; work out.
• Phát âm: nhìn chữ ear/ere/ure/air nhưng phải nhớ ngoại lệ (bear, pear, wear /eə/; here /ɪə/; ure không nhấn → /ə/).
• Word form: raise environmental awareness (n), use … efficiently (adv), a sustainable future (adj), reusable bottles (adj).
• Viết lại câu: take + thời gian + to V = It takes + thời gian + for sth + to V; instead of + V-ing = rather than + V-ing; It's hard to predict = Nobody knows for sure.

vocab.ex: The greenest classroom will win an ecotour!
Classrooms will be judged on raising environmental awareness.

vocab.vi: lượng khí thải carbon (do một người/hoạt động tạo ra)
vocab.ex: We should turn off the lights to reduce our carbon footprint.
Classrooms will be judged on using resources efficiently.
We need to use water and electricity more efficiently.
I guess we should start by cleaning up our classroom more frequently.
We need to develop eco-friendly habits in our class.
Bringing your own bottle is a good green habit.
Many students throw plastic bottles away after a single use.
Don't throw away plastic bottles – reuse them!
Plastic takes hundreds of years to decompose.
We can refill our reusable bottles from the big water jug.
I always bring my reusable water bottle to school.
Make sure you turn off the lights and air conditioners before leaving.
Leaving the lights on is a waste of electricity.
The waste in open landfill sites can release harmful gases.
A creative way to reuse old greeting cards is to make bookmarks.

vocab.vi: bao bì, vật liệu đóng gói
vocab.ex: Takeaway food includes a lot of unnecessary packaging.
I use plastic takeaway containers to store cooked food.
We always try to buy food packed in recyclable containers.
We should work out some solutions to reducing plastic pollution.
The future of our planet depends on how we deal with climate change.
The supermarket provides cardboard boxes for customers' groceries.
I can pack my groceries and get rid of plastic packaging.
Can we enjoy the convenience of plastics and a greener world at the same time?
It is convenient to buy a bottle of water from a vending machine.
I use the containers to keep leftovers in the fridge.

vocab.vi: bị nhiễm bẩn, bị ô nhiễm
vocab.ex: The whole bin was contaminated, so all the recyclables went to the landfill.
I always rinse out containers before recycling them.

vocab.vi: phân trộn, phân hữu cơ (ủ từ rác hữu cơ)
vocab.ex: Compost can be added to soil to help plants grow.
Add another layer of dry leaves on top of the fruit peels.
Household waste is often taken to landfills and buried there.
Fruit peels can be used as green materials for a compost pile.
We created a compost pile in the corner of the garden.
Don't add chemical fertilisers to the compost pile.
Install automatic lights and sensor taps that turn off when no one is around.

vocab.vi: phương tiện giao thông công cộng
vocab.ex: Encourage more students to use public transport to go to school.
Cycling to school will also lead to healthier lifestyles in the long run.
Some customs may need to be changed for a sustainable future.
The litter left behind by balloons and sky lanterns is hard to decompose.
Methane and carbon dioxide are two harmful greenhouse gases.
During their production, harmful pollutants are released into the air.

passages.title: A Plastic-Free Week at our school
passages.text: Last month, our school organised a Plastic-Free Week to raise students' environmental (1) _____. During the week, nobody was allowed to bring single-use plastic bottles or bags to school. Instead, we brought (2) _____ water bottles and refilled them at the drinking fountains. Students who bought takeaway food were asked to use their own containers, (3) _____ greatly reduced the amount of plastic packaging in the school bins. Our class also took the challenge seriously. We collected empty bottles and turned them into plant pots instead of throwing them (4) _____. At the end of the week, the Youth Union announced that the school had produced 70% less plastic waste than usual. Many students said they would keep these habits, because small changes can make a big difference (5) _____ the long run. I believe this event has helped us develop eco-friendly habits that will last for years.

passages.title: Making compost at home
passages.text: Every day, a typical family throws away a large amount of household (6) _____, and much of it ends up in landfills. However, kitchen scraps such as fruit peels and vegetable leaves can be turned into compost, (7) _____ is a natural fertiliser for plants. Creating a compost pile is easier than many people think. First, choose a corner of your garden and put down a (8) _____ of dry leaves or small branches. Next, add green materials like fruit peels and coffee grounds. Repeat these layers in the same order and water the pile regularly, because it should never be left dry. After a few months, the materials will (9) _____ into rich, dark soil. Using compost means you do not have to depend (10) _____ chemical fertilisers, which can harm the soil and water. It is a simple green habit that benefits both your garden and the planet.

questions.q: Which word means "an area of land where waste materials are buried under the surface"?
questions.explain: landfill = bãi chôn lấp rác (khu đất chôn rác thải dưới mặt đất). compost = phân trộn; packaging = bao bì; container = hộp, đồ đựng.

questions.q: Many online shops now use paper instead of plastic _____ to protect the products they send to customers.
questions.explain: packaging = bao bì, vật liệu đóng gói để bảo vệ hàng hóa. Câu: Nhiều cửa hàng online dùng giấy thay cho bao bì nhựa để bảo vệ hàng gửi khách. landfill = bãi rác; leftovers = thức ăn thừa; compost = phân trộn – không hợp nghĩa.

questions.q: Cycling to school instead of going by motorbike can help you reduce your carbon _____.
questions.explain: Cụm cố định: carbon footprint = lượng khí thải carbon do một người/hoạt động tạo ra. Các từ print, step, trace không kết hợp với carbon theo nghĩa này.

questions.q: Plastic bags can take hundreds of years to _____ in landfills.
questions.explain: decompose = phân hủy (bị phá vỡ dần một cách tự nhiên). decorate = trang trí; decrease = giảm (về số lượng); destroy = phá hủy – là ngoại động từ, cần tân ngữ, và không mang nghĩa phân hủy tự nhiên.

questions.q: Please _____ the yoghurt pots with water before putting them in the recycling bin.
questions.explain: rinse out = súc rửa, tráng sạch bên trong (with water là dấu hiệu). Phải rửa sạch hộp trước khi bỏ vào thùng tái chế để không làm bẩn cả thùng. throw away = vứt đi; pick up = nhặt lên; give off = tỏa ra (mùi, khí).

questions.q: Instead of throwing away _____, my mum keeps them in the fridge for the next meal.
questions.explain: leftovers = thức ăn thừa – thứ có thể cất tủ lạnh cho bữa sau. packaging = bao bì; landfills = bãi rác; layers = các lớp – không hợp ngữ cảnh.

questions.q:
Choose the word CLOSEST in meaning to the underlined word.
The whole recycling bin was <u>contaminated</u>, so all the recyclables were taken to the landfill.
questions.explain: contaminated = bị nhiễm bẩn, bị làm ô nhiễm ≈ polluted. purified = được làm sạch (trái nghĩa); separated = được tách riêng; emptied = được đổ hết ra.

questions.q:
Choose the word OPPOSITE in meaning to the underlined word.
Many students now bring <u>reusable</u> water bottles to school.
questions.explain: reusable = có thể dùng lại nhiều lần; trái nghĩa là single-use = dùng một lần. recyclable (có thể tái chế), eco-friendly (thân thiện môi trường), refillable (có thể đổ đầy lại) đều gần nghĩa tích cực, không trái nghĩa.

questions.q: The aim of the competition is to raise students' environmental _____.
questions.explain: Sau tính từ environmental cần một danh từ → awareness (nhận thức). Cụm: raise environmental awareness = nâng cao nhận thức về môi trường. aware/unaware là tính từ; awarely không phải từ chuẩn.

questions.q: Classrooms will be judged on how _____ they use resources such as water and electricity.
questions.explain: how + trạng từ bổ nghĩa cho động từ use → efficiently (một cách hiệu quả). efficient là tính từ; efficiency/inefficiency là danh từ.

questions.q: Let's _____ the classroom before the judges arrive. It's really messy now.
questions.explain: clean up = dọn dẹp cho sạch sẽ, gọn gàng (hợp với messy). make up = bịa ra/trang điểm; look up = tra cứu; turn up = xuất hiện/vặn to.

questions.q: The supermarket provides cardboard boxes, so customers can pack their groceries and _____ plastic packaging.
questions.explain: get rid of = loại bỏ, vứt bỏ. get on with = hòa hợp với/tiếp tục; get over = vượt qua (bệnh, nỗi buồn); get through = vượt qua (kỳ thi), gọi điện được.

questions.q: Which word means "a mixture of naturally decomposed plants, food, etc. that can be added to soil to help plants grow"?
questions.explain: compost = phân trộn, phân hữu cơ ủ từ thực vật, thức ăn đã phân hủy. pile = đống; layer = lớp; packaging = bao bì.

questions.q: First, put a thick _____ of dry leaves at the bottom of the bin, then add your fruit peels on top.
questions.explain: a layer of = một lớp. Câu mô tả cách xếp lớp lá khô dưới đáy rồi thêm vỏ trái cây lên trên. peel = vỏ; container = hộp đựng; habit = thói quen.

questions.q: Remember to _____ off the lights and air conditioners before leaving the classroom.
questions.explain: turn off = tắt (đèn, máy lạnh). take off = cởi ra/cất cánh; give off = tỏa ra (mùi, khí); get off = xuống xe.

questions.q: Bamboo straws are a(n) _____ alternative to plastic ones.
questions.explain: eco-friendly = thân thiện với môi trường – ống hút tre là lựa chọn thay thế xanh cho ống hút nhựa. harmful (có hại), toxic (độc hại), wasteful (lãng phí) đều mang nghĩa tiêu cực, không hợp.

questions.q: Cycling to school will lead to healthier lifestyles in the long _____.
questions.explain: Thành ngữ in the long run = về lâu dài (Everyday English – Making predictions). Các từ road, walk, race không tạo thành thành ngữ này.
questions.review: Lớp 12 · Unit 3 – Communication and Culture, Everyday English (tr. 40)

questions.q: Some festival customs may need to be changed for a _____ future.
questions.explain: Giữa mạo từ a và danh từ future cần tính từ → sustainable (bền vững). sustain là động từ; sustainability là danh từ; sustainably là trạng từ.
questions.review: Lớp 12 · Unit 3 – Communication and Culture, CLIL (tr. 41)

questions.q: When real Christmas trees go to landfills, they produce methane and carbon dioxide, which are two harmful _____ gases.
questions.explain: greenhouse gases = khí nhà kính (methane, CO2). glasshouse/hothouse = nhà kính trồng cây (không dùng với gases theo nghĩa này); warehouse = nhà kho.
questions.review: Lớp 12 · Unit 3 – Communication and Culture, CLIL (tr. 41)

questions.q:
Choose the word OPPOSITE in meaning to the underlined word.
Fireworks release a lot of <u>harmful</u> chemicals into the air.
questions.explain: harmful = có hại; trái nghĩa là harmless = vô hại. dangerous, toxic, poisonous đều đồng nghĩa với harmful.
questions.review: Lớp 12 · Unit 3 – Communication and Culture, CLIL (tr. 41)

questions.q: Young people today care a lot _____ climate change.
questions.explain: care about sth = quan tâm đến điều gì. care for = chăm sóc / thích (không hợp với climate change); care with, care on không đúng.

questions.q: Whether we can reduce plastic waste depends _____ our daily habits.
questions.explain: depend on = phụ thuộc vào. Câu: Việc ta có giảm được rác nhựa hay không phụ thuộc vào thói quen hằng ngày.

questions.q: Tom apologised _____ leaving the lights on in the classroom.
questions.explain: apologise (to sb) for (doing) sth = xin lỗi vì đã làm gì. Sau giới từ for dùng V-ing (leaving).

questions.q: Many supermarkets now rely _____ cardboard boxes instead of plastic bags.
questions.explain: rely on = dựa vào, trông cậy vào. Các giới từ in, at, for không đi với rely.

questions.q: Our class has to work _____ a plan to reduce our carbon footprint before Friday.
questions.explain: work out = tìm ra, nghĩ ra (giải pháp, kế hoạch) – cụm động từ có nghĩa khác động từ gốc. work off (giải tỏa, trả dần), work away (làm việc miệt mài), work in (lồng vào) không hợp với a plan.

questions.q: While my parents are away, I have to look _____ our plants and water them every day.
questions.explain: look after = chăm sóc. look up = tra cứu; look into = điều tra, xem xét; look for = tìm kiếm – không hợp với "water them every day".

questions.q: Can you look _____ the word 'compost' in the dictionary? I don't know what it means.
questions.explain: look up a word (in the dictionary) = tra từ. look after = chăm sóc; look out = coi chừng; look over = xem qua, kiểm tra.

questions.q: The students carried _____ a survey on how much plastic waste their school produces.
questions.explain: carry out a survey = tiến hành một cuộc khảo sát. carry on = tiếp tục (thường carry on doing/with sth); carry off = giành được; carry away = cuốn đi.

questions.q: The teacher explained _____ us how to sort waste into different bins.
questions.explain: explain sth to sb / explain to sb + wh-clause = giải thích cho ai. Không dùng explain for/with/at sb.

questions.q: Our report on green solutions is based _____ a survey of 200 students.
questions.explain: be based on = dựa trên. Câu: Báo cáo của chúng tôi dựa trên khảo sát 200 học sinh.

questions.q: Instead of throwing old notebooks _____, we use the blank pages to take notes.
questions.explain: throw sth away = vứt bỏ. Instead of + V-ing: thay vì vứt vở cũ đi, chúng tôi dùng trang trắng để ghi chép.

questions.q: I'm thinking _____ joining the school's Green Club this year.
questions.explain: think about (doing) sth = cân nhắc, suy nghĩ về việc gì. think on/for/to không đúng trong ngữ cảnh này.

questions.topic: Relative clauses referring to a whole sentence
questions.q: More and more people use reusable bags, _____ helps reduce plastic waste.
questions.explain: Mệnh đề quan hệ không xác định thay cho cả mệnh đề trước dùng ", which". that không dùng sau dấu phẩy; what không làm đại từ quan hệ có tiền ngữ; who chỉ người.

questions.topic: Relative clauses referring to a whole sentence
questions.q: Mai always turns off the fans when she leaves the room, _____ saves a lot of energy.
questions.explain: which thay cho cả việc "Mai luôn tắt quạt khi rời phòng". it/this sau dấu phẩy tạo hai mệnh đề độc lập nối bằng dấu phẩy (sai); what không dùng sau dấu phẩy để thay cả câu.

questions.topic: Relative clauses referring to a whole sentence
questions.q: Lan forgot to rinse out the yoghurt pots, _____ contaminated the whole recycling bin.
questions.explain: which thay cho cả sự việc "Lan quên tráng hộp sữa chua" và làm chủ ngữ của contaminated. what, that không đứng sau dấu phẩy theo cách này; whom chỉ người, làm tân ngữ.

questions.topic: Relative clauses referring to a whole sentence
questions.q: Plastic takes hundreds of years to decompose, which _____ why it is harmful to the environment.
questions.explain: which thay cho cả mệnh đề trước nên được coi là chủ ngữ số ít → động từ chia số ít: explains. explaining/to explain không làm vị ngữ được; explain thiếu -s.

questions.topic: Relative clauses referring to a whole sentence
questions.q: Choose the correct sentence.
options: Many students cycle to school, that reduces air pollution.
Many students cycle to school, which reduces air pollution.
Many students cycle to school, what reduces air pollution.
Many students cycle to school, which reduce air pollution.
questions.explain: Mệnh đề quan hệ thay cho cả câu: dấu phẩy + which + động từ số ít (reduces). Dùng that hoặc what sau dấu phẩy là sai; reduce chia số nhiều là sai vì which thay cho cả sự việc (số ít).

questions.topic: Relative clauses referring to a whole sentence
questions.q: Our class won the Green Classroom Competition, _____ made our teacher very proud.
questions.explain: which thay cho cả sự việc "lớp thắng cuộc thi" (điều đó làm cô giáo tự hào). who chỉ người; that không dùng sau dấu phẩy; where chỉ nơi chốn.

questions.topic: Relative clauses referring to a whole sentence
questions.q: Some students leave the lights on when they rush out, which _____ a waste of electricity.
questions.explain: which thay cho cả sự việc → động từ số ít, thì hiện tại phù hợp với câu (leave, rush) → is. are là số nhiều; were being, be sai thì/dạng.

questions.topic: Relative clauses referring to a whole sentence
questions.q: We reuse plastic containers to store leftovers, _____ is better _____ the environment.
questions.explain: ", which" thay cho cả việc tái sử dụng hộp nhựa; cụm be good/better for sth = tốt cho cái gì. that, what không dùng sau dấu phẩy; better with/to the environment sai giới từ.

questions.q: Choose the word whose underlined part is pronounced differently from the others.
questions.explain: appear /əˈpɪə(r)/: ear đọc /ɪə/. wear /weə(r)/, bear /beə(r)/, pear /peə(r)/: ear đọc /eə/. Lưu ý: cùng chữ ear nhưng có hai cách đọc.

questions.q: Choose the word whose underlined part is pronounced differently from the others.
questions.explain: swear /sweə(r)/: ear đọc /eə/. near /nɪə(r)/, clear /klɪə(r)/, year /jɪə(r)/: ear đọc /ɪə/.

questions.q: Choose the word whose underlined part is pronounced differently from the others.
questions.explain: picture /ˈpɪktʃə(r)/: ure ở âm tiết không nhấn đọc /ə/. pure /pjʊə(r)/, cure /kjʊə(r)/, mature /məˈtʃʊə(r)/: ure đọc /ʊə/.

questions.q: Choose the word whose underlined part is pronounced differently from the others.
questions.explain: here /hɪə(r)/: ere đọc /ɪə/. where /weə(r)/, there /ðeə(r)/, anywhere /ˈeniweə(r)/: ere đọc /eə/.

questions.q: Choose the word whose underlined part is pronounced differently from the others.
questions.explain: are /ɑː(r)/: are đọc /ɑː/. aware /əˈweə(r)/, care /keə(r)/, share /ʃeə(r)/: are đọc /eə/.

questions.q: Choose the word whose underlined part is pronounced differently from the others.
questions.explain: green /ɡriːn/: ee đọc /iː/. career /kəˈrɪə(r)/, cheerful /ˈtʃɪəfl/, steer /stɪə(r)/: eer đọc /ɪə/ (ee trước r).

questions.q: Choose the word whose underlined part is pronounced differently from the others.
questions.explain: remain /rɪˈmeɪn/: ai đọc /eɪ/. fair /feə(r)/, stairs /steəz/, repair /rɪˈpeə(r)/: ai trước r đọc /eə/.

questions.q: Choose the word that differs from the others in the position of primary stress.
questions.explain: reduce /rɪˈdjuːs/ nhấn âm 2. landfill /ˈlændfɪl/, compost /ˈkɒmpɒst/, layer /ˈleɪə(r)/ nhấn âm 1.

questions.q: Choose the word that differs from the others in the position of primary stress.
questions.explain: decompose /ˌdiːkəmˈpəʊz/ nhấn âm 3. container /kənˈteɪnə(r)/, recycle /ˌriːˈsaɪkl/, pollutant /pəˈluːtənt/ nhấn âm 2.

questions.q: Choose the word that differs from the others in the position of primary stress.
questions.explain: pollution /pəˈluːʃn/ nhấn âm 2. packaging /ˈpækɪdʒɪŋ/, leftovers /ˈleftəʊvəz/, cardboard /ˈkɑːdbɔːd/ nhấn âm 1.

questions.q: Choose the word that differs from the others in the position of primary stress.
questions.explain: environmental /ɪnˌvaɪrənˈmentl/ nhấn âm 4. environment /ɪnˈvaɪrənmənt/, sustainable /səˈsteɪnəbl/, contaminate /kənˈtæmɪneɪt/ nhấn âm 2.

questions.q: Choose the word that differs from the others in the position of primary stress.
questions.explain: fertiliser /ˈfɜːtəlaɪzə(r)/ nhấn âm 1. recyclable /ˌriːˈsaɪkləbl/, reusable /ˌriːˈjuːzəbl/, convenience /kənˈviːniəns/ nhấn âm 2.

questions.q:
Find the underlined part that needs correction.
The success of the project <u>depends in</u> (A) how <u>actively</u> (B) students <u>take part</u> (C) <u>in</u> (D) it.
questions.explain: Lỗi ở A: depend đi với giới từ on → sửa depends in thành depends on. take part in = tham gia là đúng.

questions.q:
Find the underlined part that needs correction.
Nam <u>apologised</u> (A) <u>about</u> (B) leaving the tap <u>running</u> (C) <u>in</u> (D) the restroom.
questions.explain: Lỗi ở B: apologise (to sb) for (doing) sth → sửa about thành for. leave the tap running = để vòi nước chảy là đúng.

questions.topic: Relative clauses referring to a whole sentence
questions.q:
Find the underlined part that needs correction.
More people <u>are</u> (A) <u>interested in</u> (B) recycling nowadays, <u>that</u> (C) is <u>good for</u> (D) the environment.
questions.explain: Lỗi ở C: mệnh đề quan hệ không xác định thay cho cả câu phải dùng ", which", không dùng that sau dấu phẩy → sửa that thành which.

questions.topic: Relative clauses referring to a whole sentence
questions.q:
Find the underlined part that needs correction.
We always rinse out containers <u>before</u> (A) <u>recycling</u> (B) them, <u>which</u> (C) <u>prevent</u> (D) the recycling bin from being contaminated.
questions.explain: Lỗi ở D: which thay cho cả sự việc (việc tráng hộp trước khi tái chế) nên động từ chia số ít → sửa prevent thành prevents.

questions.q:
Find the underlined part that needs correction.
<u>Instead to</u> (A) throwing old paper away, we <u>use</u> (B) it <u>as</u> (C) compost <u>for</u> (D) our garden.
questions.explain: Lỗi ở A: cụm đúng là instead of + V-ing (thay vì) → sửa Instead to thành Instead of.

questions.q:
Find the underlined part that needs correction.
Plastic <u>takes</u> (A) hundreds of years to <u>decomposing</u> (B) in landfills, <u>which</u> (C) is <u>harmful to</u> (D) the environment.
questions.explain: Lỗi ở B: cấu trúc take + thời gian + to V (nguyên thể) → sửa decomposing thành decompose.

questions.q:
Find the underlined part that needs correction.
You can <u>reduce</u> (A) your carbon <u>footprint</u> (B) by <u>turn off</u> (C) the lights <u>when</u> (D) you leave the room.
questions.explain: Lỗi ở C: sau giới từ by phải dùng V-ing → sửa turn off thành turning off.

questions.topic: Relative clauses referring to a whole sentence
questions.q:
Find the underlined part that needs correction.
She <u>always</u> (A) <u>keeps</u> (B) <u>leftovers</u> (C) in the fridge, <u>what</u> (D) helps her waste less food.
questions.explain: Lỗi ở D: thay cho cả mệnh đề trước, sau dấu phẩy phải dùng which, không dùng what → sửa what thành which.

questions.q:
Choose the sentence that is closest in meaning to the given sentence.
It's hard to predict who will win the Green Classroom Competition.
options: Everyone knows who will win the Green Classroom Competition.
It's easy to say who will win the Green Classroom Competition.
Nobody knows for sure who will win the Green Classroom Competition.
Our class is going to win the Green Classroom Competition.
questions.explain: It's hard to predict = khó mà đoán trước → không ai biết chắc ai sẽ thắng. Các câu còn lại đều khẳng định đã biết/dễ đoán kết quả, trái nghĩa với câu gốc.
questions.review: Lớp 12 · Unit 3 – Communication and Culture, Everyday English (tr. 40)

questions.topic: Relative clauses referring to a whole sentence
questions.q:
Choose the sentence that is closest in meaning to the given sentence.
More and more people are interested in recycling nowadays, which is good for the environment.
options: The fact that more and more people are interested in recycling nowadays is good for the environment.
More and more people are interested in recycling nowadays because it is good for the environment.
More and more people are not interested in recycling nowadays, which is bad for the environment.
Recycling is good for the environment, so people are no longer interested in it.
questions.explain: which thay cho cả sự việc "ngày càng nhiều người quan tâm tái chế" → chính sự việc đó tốt cho môi trường. Câu dùng because biến nó thành lý do người ta quan tâm (đổi nghĩa); hai câu còn lại nói ngược ý.

questions.q:
Choose the sentence that is closest in meaning to the given sentence.
The whole bin was contaminated, so all the recyclables were taken to the landfill.
options: Although the bin was contaminated, all the recyclables were recycled.
The whole bin was contaminated because the recyclables were taken to the landfill.
The recyclables were taken to the landfill, but the bin was not contaminated.
All the recyclables were taken to the landfill because the whole bin was contaminated.
questions.explain: Câu gốc: thùng bị nhiễm bẩn (nguyên nhân) → đồ tái chế bị đưa ra bãi rác (kết quả). Câu đúng đổi so thành because nhưng giữ quan hệ nhân – quả. Các câu khác đảo nhân – quả hoặc sai sự thật.

questions.q:
Choose the sentence that is closest in meaning to the given sentence.
Plastic takes hundreds of years to decompose.
options: Plastic decomposes within a few years.
It takes hundreds of years for plastic to decompose.
It takes plastic to decompose hundreds of years.
Hundreds of years are taken by plastic decomposing.
questions.explain: Cấu trúc tương đương: S + take(s) + thời gian + to V = It takes + thời gian + for sb/sth + to V. Câu "within a few years" sai nghĩa; hai câu còn lại sai cấu trúc.

questions.q:
Choose the sentence that is closest in meaning to the given sentence.
Using reusable bottles is better for the environment than buying single-use ones.
options: Buying single-use bottles is not as good for the environment as using reusable ones.
Buying single-use bottles is better for the environment than using reusable ones.
Using reusable bottles is as bad for the environment as buying single-use ones.
Reusable bottles are not so good for the environment as single-use ones.
questions.explain: A better than B = B not as good as A. Câu đúng giữ nguyên ý: mua chai dùng một lần không tốt cho môi trường bằng dùng chai tái sử dụng. Các câu khác đảo ngược hoặc đánh đồng hai việc.

questions.q:
Choose the sentence that is closest in meaning to the given sentence.
Instead of throwing plastic bottles away, we make plant pots from them.
options: We throw plastic bottles away and then make plant pots.
We throw away the plant pots made from plastic bottles.
We make plant pots from plastic bottles rather than throwing them away.
We neither throw plastic bottles away nor make plant pots from them.
questions.explain: instead of + V-ing = rather than + V-ing (thay vì). Câu đúng: làm chậu cây từ chai nhựa thay vì vứt chúng đi. Các câu khác hoặc vẫn vứt chai, hoặc phủ định việc làm chậu.

questions.topic: Relative clauses referring to a whole sentence
questions.q:
Choose the sentence that best combines each pair of sentences.
Our class turns off all the lights during break time. This saves a lot of electricity.
options: Our class turns off all the lights during break time, that saves a lot of electricity.
Our class turns off all the lights during break time, which saves a lot of electricity.
Our class turns off all the lights during break time, which save a lot of electricity.
Our class turns off all the lights during break time which it saves a lot of electricity.
questions.explain: This thay cho cả câu trước → dùng ", which" + động từ số ít (saves). that không dùng sau dấu phẩy; save chia sai; "which it saves" thừa chủ ngữ it.

questions.topic: Relative clauses referring to a whole sentence
questions.q:
Choose the sentence that best combines each pair of sentences.
Many people throw plastic bottles away after a single use. This is not good for the environment.
options: Many people throw plastic bottles away after a single use, who is not good for the environment.
Many people throw plastic bottles away after a single use, it is not good for the environment.
Many people who throw plastic bottles away after a single use is not good for the environment.
Many people throw plastic bottles away after a single use, which is not good for the environment.
questions.explain: This chỉ cả hành động vứt chai sau một lần dùng → ", which is not good…". who chỉ người; dùng ", it" là lỗi nối hai mệnh đề bằng dấu phẩy; câu cuối sai hòa hợp chủ – vị (people … is) và đổi nghĩa.

questions.topic: Relative clauses referring to a whole sentence
questions.q:
Choose the sentence that best combines each pair of sentences.
Students put containers with leftovers into the recycling bin. That can contaminate the recyclable waste.
options: Students put containers with leftovers into the recycling bin, which can contaminate the recyclable waste.
Students put containers with leftovers into the recycling bin, what can contaminate the recyclable waste.
Students put containers with leftovers into the recycling bin, which can contaminates the recyclable waste.
Students put containers with leftovers into the recycling bin, where can contaminate the recyclable waste.
questions.explain: That chỉ cả hành vi bỏ hộp còn thức ăn thừa vào thùng tái chế → ", which can contaminate…". what không dùng sau dấu phẩy; sau can phải là động từ nguyên thể; where chỉ nơi chốn và không làm chủ ngữ.

questions.topic: Relative clauses referring to a whole sentence
questions.q:
Choose the sentence that best combines each pair of sentences.
Our school has installed automatic lights in all classrooms. The teachers are very pleased about this.
options: Our school has installed automatic lights in all classrooms, that the teachers are very pleased about.
Our school has installed automatic lights in all classrooms, which the teachers are very pleased about it.
Our school has installed automatic lights in all classrooms, which the teachers are very pleased about.
Our school has installed automatic lights in all classrooms, which the teachers are very pleased.
questions.explain: this chỉ cả việc trường lắp đèn tự động; which làm tân ngữ của giới từ about (be pleased about sth). Không dùng that sau dấu phẩy; thêm it là thừa tân ngữ; bỏ about là thiếu giới từ.

questions.q: Choose the best option for blank (1).
questions.explain: Sau tính từ environmental cần danh từ; cụm raise environmental awareness = nâng cao nhận thức về môi trường. aware là tính từ; awake = thức; awarely không phải từ chuẩn.

questions.q: Choose the best option for blank (2).
questions.explain: Trước danh từ water bottles cần tính từ; ngữ cảnh "cấm chai dùng một lần… và đổ đầy lại" → reusable (tái sử dụng). disposable = dùng xong vứt (trái ý); single không hợp nghĩa; reuse là động từ.

questions.topic: Relative clauses referring to a whole sentence
questions.q: Choose the best option for blank (3).
questions.explain: ", which" thay cho cả sự việc "học sinh dùng hộp đựng riêng" và làm chủ ngữ của reduced. that không dùng sau dấu phẩy; what không có tiền ngữ; who chỉ người.

questions.q: Choose the best option for blank (4).
questions.explain: throw sth away = vứt bỏ; instead of throwing them away = thay vì vứt chúng đi. for, with, on không tạo nghĩa phù hợp.

questions.q: Choose the best option for blank (5).
questions.explain: Thành ngữ in the long run = về lâu dài: những thay đổi nhỏ có thể tạo khác biệt lớn về lâu dài.
questions.review: Lớp 12 · Unit 3 – Communication and Culture, Everyday English (tr. 40)

questions.q: Choose the best option for blank (6).
questions.explain: household waste = rác thải sinh hoạt (danh từ không đếm được, làm tân ngữ của throws away). wasteful là tính từ; wasted là quá khứ phân từ; wastefully là trạng từ.

questions.q: Choose the best option for blank (7).
questions.explain: Mệnh đề quan hệ không xác định bổ sung cho danh từ compost (không phải thay cho cả câu), đứng sau dấu phẩy → which. that không dùng sau dấu phẩy; what không có tiền ngữ; where chỉ nơi chốn.

questions.q: Choose the best option for blank (8).
questions.explain: a layer of dry leaves = một lớp lá khô; đoạn sau nhắc "Repeat these layers" xác nhận đáp án. slice = lát (bánh mì…); bottle, packet = chai, gói – không hợp với lá khô.

questions.q: Choose the best option for blank (9).
questions.explain: decompose (into) = phân hủy thành: sau vài tháng, vật liệu phân hủy thành đất tơi xốp. compose = sáng tác; recycle into cần chủ thể con người tái chế; destroy là ngoại động từ, không đi với into theo nghĩa này.

questions.q: Choose the best option for blank (10).
questions.explain: depend on = phụ thuộc vào: dùng phân trộn thì không phải phụ thuộc vào phân bón hóa học.
